notes: Desktop reached a measured 100 in every Lighthouse category.
Mobile reached 100 in Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO; the final measured Performance run was 97, with observed repeat-run variance.
The required 0–100 loading counter, exact external Plus Jakarta Sans stylesheet and normal mobile lab variance prevent a defensible guarantee of 100 mobile Performance.

Scores are lab observations, not field Core Web Vitals or ranking guarantees.
